title: M5 · The shared Registration link box
intro: One box everywhere, as the design review decided (rulebook v1.015, picture 12): Copy link and Download QR code in every section (new for Color Belt and Star), Print flyer where a section has one today; one or two school links. Real QR codes. Amber outline = what the shared box decides. Two details to OK: (a) a failed copy or download shows its amber note inside the box, where the person is looking (5) — today Color Belt, Camps and Black Belt put it in a bar on the page behind; (b) Download QR code saves a 1024-pixel PNG (big enough to print; Camps' size today) named like “November Children Testing - Worcester QR code.png” in every section. Every state at all four sizes: M5-registration-link.png.

sections.head: Black Belt — two links, no flyer, a line of its own
If Download or Copy fails — detail (a): the note inside the box

footer: What changes for each section when it switches (later, in its own prompt): Color Belt and Star gain Download QR code (v1.015) · Color Belt, Camps and Black Belt show a failed copy inside the box, not in a bar behind it · Black Belt's QR picture grows from about 450 to 1024 pixels, and Camps' file name (“april-vacation-camp-qr.png” today) takes the shared form · the QR code itself is made exactly as today. Forms keeps its own Share box (it also holds kiosk mode, v1.015).
